#RNAseq ECM Analysis

Lets look at the gene exppression of ECM genes across primary and recurrent GBM in the TCGA and CGGA datasets. 

## Download and upload input data

Data downloaded from https://www.cgga.org.cn/download.jsp and https://gliovis.bioinfo.cnio.es/

### Filtering data to only include samples that follow WHO 2021 classification. 

Removed Samples that are not classified as GBM. Removed samples that do not have IDH-Status = Wildtype

```{r}
# CGGA phenotype
cgga_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/2025-07-31_CGGA_pheno.txt", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# TCGA phenotype
tcga_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/2025-07-31_TCGA_GBM_pheno.txt", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

CGGA Filtering
```{r}
cgga_filtered_meta <- cgga_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Histology = trimws(tolower(Histology)),
    IDH_status = trimws(tolower(IDH_status)),
    Recurrence = trimws(tolower(Recurrence)),
    co_del_1p19q = trimws(tolower(co_del_1p19q))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Histology == "gbm" &
    IDH_status == "wildtype" &
    Recurrence != "secondary" &
    co_del_1p19q != "codel"
  )

```

TCGA Filtering
```{r}
tcga_filtered_meta <- tcga_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Histology = trimws(tolower(Histology)),
    IDH1_status = trimws(tolower(IDH1_status))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (Histology == "gbm" & IDH1_status == "wild-type") |
    (Histology == "non-tumor")
  )
```

Okay, now all data has been filtered to just include GBM, IDH WT, and non-codel qp19q. 

### Match filtered data to expression data. 

For CGGA
```{r}
# Load CGGA expression data
expr_raw <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Match sample between the metadata and the expression
matched_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_raw), cgga_filtered_meta$Sample)

# Subset data
CGGA_expr <- expr_raw[, matched_samples]
cgga_filtered_meta <- cgga_filtered_meta[cgga_filtered_meta$Sample %in% matched_samples, ]
```

For TCGA
```{r}
# Load TCGA expression data
tcga_expr_raw <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/2025-07-31_TCGA_GBM_expression.txt", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Transpose because expression data has sample id as row
tcga_expr_fixed <- as.data.frame(t(tcga_expr_raw))

# Match
matched_samples <- intersect(colnames(tcga_expr_fixed), tcga_filtered_meta$Sample)

# Subset
TCGA_expr <- tcga_expr_fixed[, matched_samples]
tcga_filtered_meta <- tcga_filtered_meta[tcga_filtered_meta$Sample %in% matched_samples, ]
```

### CGGA Data is not Log2 transformed

```{r}
# Apply log2(x + 1) transformation to all values
CGGA_expr_log2 <- log2(CGGA_expr + 1)

# Sanity check: look at value range
summary(as.numeric(unlist(CGGA_expr_log2[, 1:5])))
```

## GO ECM Gene Set Analysis

Gene set to be used GO:0031012 (Extracellular Matrix)

```{r}
# Load biomaRt
library(biomaRt)

# Connect to Ensembl BioMart (human dataset)
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# Query human genes annotated with GO:0031012
ecm_genes_raw <- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "go_id", "name_1006"),
  filters = "go",
  values = "GO:0031012",
  mart = ensembl
)

# Clean: filter to human genes only and remove blanks/duplicates
ecm_genes <- ecm_genes_raw %>%
  filter(hgnc_symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(hgnc_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Extract unique gene symbols
ecm_gene_list <- unique(ecm_genes$hgnc_symbol)

# Preview
head(ecm_gene_list)
length(ecm_gene_list)

```
## Subset expression data using ECM gene set

```{r}
# Subset CGGA
CGGA_ECM_expr <- CGGA_expr_log2[rownames(CGGA_expr_log2) %in% ecm_gene_list, ]

# Subset TCGA
TCGA_ECM_expr <- TCGA_expr[rownames(TCGA_expr) %in% ecm_gene_list, ]

```

## Heatmap for ECM gene expression

### TCGA ECM analysis
```{r}
# Load pheatmap
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
# Coerce everything to numeric and keep gene rownames
TCGA_ECM_expr_clean <- TCGA_ECM_expr %>%
  mutate_all(as.numeric) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(TCGA_ECM_expr_clean) <- rownames(TCGA_ECM_expr)

```

```{r}
# Remove genes (rows) with all NA
TCGA_ECM_expr_clean <- TCGA_ECM_expr_clean[rowSums(is.na(TCGA_ECM_expr_clean)) < ncol(TCGA_ECM_expr_clean), ]

# Remove samples (columns) with all NA
TCGA_ECM_expr_clean <- TCGA_ECM_expr_clean[, colSums(is.na(TCGA_ECM_expr_clean)) < nrow(TCGA_ECM_expr_clean)]

# Remove genes with zero variance (flat expression)
TCGA_ECM_expr_clean <- TCGA_ECM_expr_clean[apply(TCGA_ECM_expr_clean, 1, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0), ]

```

```{r}
# Create clean annotation dataframe
tcga_anno_clean <- data.frame(Histology = tcga_filtered_meta$Histology)
rownames(tcga_anno_clean) <- tcga_filtered_meta$Sample

# Restrict and order annotations to match expression matrix
tcga_anno_clean <- tcga_anno_clean[colnames(TCGA_ECM_expr_clean), , drop = FALSE]

```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  TCGA_ECM_expr_clean,
  annotation_col = tcga_anno_clean,
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  clustering_method = "complete",
  main = "TCGA GBM vs Non-Tumor ECM Gene Expression"
)

```
